hypothesis: The frozen clean public runtime tuple reproduces the incumbent profile within every stored non-regression tolerance on the authorized RTX 5090.
falsifier: Any identity mismatch, profile metric below its frozen tolerance, fatal runtime condition, or failed owner-service restore falsifies the pilot.

decision_rules.accept: All frozen profile checks pass and rollback is proven.
decision_rules.reject: Any profile check fails or runtime identity differs.
decision_rules.futility: Not applicable to the single baseline pilot.
decision_rules.abort: Abort on OOM, engine death, fallback, or failed restore.
